title: 第三千三百七十六章 不一样的殷洛璃第三千三百七十五章 禁制
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
秦天花了半个时辰才在不触发任何禁制的前提下，摸到了祭坛正下方的地宫入口。
地宫入口藏在一处坍塌了一半的石殿里，石殿的柱子横七竖八地倒在地上，看起来已经荒废了不知多少年。
秦天找到一个向下延伸的石阶，尽头一片漆黑。
他沿着石阶走下去。
石阶很长，两壁刻满了密密麻麻的壁画，内容是一些古老的祭祀场景，无数修士跪在祭坛前，头顶的天门令化作光柱冲天而起。
壁画的风格粗犷而诡异，人物的面容都被刻意模糊了，只留下空洞的眼睛。
石阶走到底，是一扇半开的石门。
秦天推门进去。
里面是一个圆形石室，直径大约五丈，石室中央立着符文阵眼。
秦天稍作犹豫后，尝试破坏。
他刚破开阵法，场中便被烟雾笼罩。
等他恢复视线的时候，发现自己站在了一片竹林里。
竹叶青翠，阳光很好，空气中弥漫着淡淡的茶香，远处有一座小竹屋，竹屋前有一道溪流。
而竹屋里面似乎有人。
秦天有些疑惑，他一边思索，一边感知四周的情况。
很快，他知道是怎么回事了。
这是心魔幻境？
心魔幻境是上古修士用来考验道心的禁制，不会直接杀人，但会把闯入者心底最深处的欲望掏出来，铺成一个以假乱真的世界。
被考验的人如果看不穿幻境，就会永远沉沦其中。
如果看穿了但破不了，也会被困到肉身枯死为止。

秦天的嘴角抽了一下，眸中浮现出一抹不屑的表情，然后迈步朝竹屋走去。
竹屋不大，里面只有一间房。
房间里的陈设很简单，一张竹桌，两把竹椅，一张竹床，窗台上摆着一盆兰花。
兰花开了，淡淡的香气混在茶香里，很好闻。
厨房里有一个人。
殷洛璃站在灶台前，正在煮茶。
她穿着一身淡青色的布裙，头发随意地挽在脑后，露出修长的脖颈。
阳光从厨房的小窗照进来，落在她侧脸上，让原本冷艳的她，多了一丝媚态。
“回来了？”
殷洛璃回头看了他一眼，语气温柔，“今天怎么这么早？外面的事忙完了？”
秦天靠在门框上，看着她。
content_en:
It took Qin Tian half an hour to reach the entrance to the underground palace directly under the altar without triggering any restrictions.
The entrance to the underground palace is hidden in a half-collapsed stone hall. The pillars of the stone hall fell to the ground in a mess, and it looked like it had been abandoned for countless years.
Qin Tian found a stone staircase extending downward, and it was pitch black at the end.
He walked down the stone steps.
The stone steps are very long, and the two walls are covered with dense murals. The contents are some ancient sacrificial scenes. Countless monks kneel in front of the altar, and the Heavenly Gate Order above their heads turns into a pillar of light and rises into the sky.
The style of the mural is rough and weird, and the faces of the characters are deliberately blurred, leaving only empty eyes.
At the end of the stone steps, there is a half-open stone door.
Qin Tian pushed the door open and went in.
Inside is a circular stone chamber, about five feet in diameter, with a rune formation eye standing in the center of the stone chamber.
After Qin Tian hesitated for a moment, he tried to destroy it.
As soon as he broke through the formation, the field was enveloped in smoke.
When he regained his sight, he found himself standing in a bamboo forest.
The bamboo leaves are green, the sunshine is very good, the air is filled with the faint fragrance of tea, there is a small bamboo house in the distance, and there is a stream in front of the bamboo house.
There seemed to be someone inside the bamboo house.
Qin Tian was a little confused. He was thinking and sensing the situation around him.
Soon, he knew what was going on.
Is this a demonic fantasy?
The inner demon illusion is a prohibition used by ancient monks to test the Taoist heart. It will not directly kill people, but will take out the deepest desires in the intruder's heart and create a world that is fake and real.
If the person being tested cannot see through the illusion, he will sink into it forever.
If you see through it but cannot break it, you will be trapped until your body dies.
The corner of Qin Tian's mouth twitched, a look of disdain appeared in his eyes, and then he walked towards the bamboo house.
The bamboo house is not big, with only one room inside.
The furnishings in the room are very simple, including a bamboo table, two bamboo chairs, a bamboo bed, and a pot of orchids on the windowsill.
The orchids are blooming, and the faint fragrance is mixed with the fragrance of tea, which smells very good.
There is a man in the kitchen.
Yin Luoli stood in front of the stove, making tea.
She was wearing a light blue sarong, and her hair was pulled back casually, exposing her slender neck.
The sunlight shone in from the small window in the kitchen and fell on the side of her face, giving her originally cold and charming look a hint of charm.
"Back?"
Yin Luoli looked back at him and said in a gentle tone, "Why is it so early today? Have you finished your work outside?"
Qin Tian leaned against the door frame and looked at her.
